question: Same two user videos: MediaPipe Full versus OpenPose BODY25 extraction speed, landmark disagreement, and frozen GDI normal-minus-abnormal ordering
authorization: User explicitly requested applying MediaPipe to both own videos and comparing speed, joints and the unchanged GDI predictor
frames: Every original decoded frame, no resampling, reflection, side swapping or cropping outside each model's built-in input pipeline. Each clip starts with fresh tracking state.
timestamps: OpenCV decoded presentation time rounded to ms; when rounding yields non-increasing values, use previous_ms+1 for the tracker only and record the adjustment. Original frame indices, coordinates and GDI windows remain unchanged.
mapping: Image x*width,y*height; anatomical hip/knee/ankle mapping. MP left/right foot_index 31/32 approximate BODY25 big_toe 19/22. No use of world landmarks or z. Other BODY25 joints remain missing because the frozen feature pipeline does not consume them.
confidence: Retain all returned coordinates and raw visibility/presence. No new coordinate confidence threshold: existing feature extraction discards confidence columns. visibility<0.5 is a descriptive diagnostic only, not a claim of calibrated equivalence to OpenPose confidence.
target: Single actor setting, num_poses=1; not equivalent to OpenPose's multiple-person rejection. Fixed-frame overlays will check target plausibility.
gdi: Reuse exact previous 32 requested windows, full-record interpolation/smoothing, required-coordinate missing<=25%, 54 checkpoints and stored calibration/combination weights. No tuning, refit, score-based window selection, or automatic fallback.
comparison: Describe normal-minus-abnormal means, all five fold differences and per-window results. Positive sign indicates maintained ordering only for this pair, not clinical validity or diagnostic accuracy. If windows fail, report failures and matched accepted windows, never substitute intervals.
pose: On jointly observed frames, report per-joint pixel distance and distance normalized by OpenPose leg length; do not treat OpenPose as ground truth. Report missing frames, low visibility, and diagnostic alternative left/right correspondence without swapping data. Use identical previously fixed 42 review frames.
speed: Full MediaPipe extraction on local CPU with inference and wall time separated; reuse previous full GPU OpenPose records only as a different-hardware reference. Also rerun the same 50 frames (first25 each clip) locally for both engines, warm model initialization excluded, sequential execution; OpenPose neural output and MediaPipe final landmark output are different scopes and reported explicitly.
limits: no annotated joint or true GDI ground truth
